purpose: Quantify the contribution of the safety and discontinuity components of the successful v3 hybrid on the already-frozen v3 evaluation set.
claim_boundary: Post-confirmation descriptive ablation on the v3 cases; not an independent blind confirmation and not part of the strong-20% gate.

burgers.cases: Reuse all 60 v3 amplitude-viscosity pairs per seed.

variants.full: spatial jump sensor + viscous transition gate + 5% cell-TV projection
variants.no_spatial_jump_condition: ungated DKAN reconstruction already present in the v3 benchmark payload
variants.no_viscous_transition_gate: retain spatial jump sensor and TV projection but remove the analytic viscous-width gate
variants.no_tv_projection: retain both sensors but remove the final TV projection

burgers.primary: geometric mean normalized L2 and worst pair; also maximum TV excess, overshoot, and cell-average change

variants.full: 0.75 learned blend and fixed-MC fallback above 200 cells
variants.no_trust_region: learned blend multiplier 1.0 with the same 200-cell resolution gate

euler.primary: geometric mean primitive-composite L2 and worst pair; also RH ratio, positivity, entropy, and cell-average change

entropy_note: The successful subcell networks were not trained with a separable entropy-loss coefficient. Entropy admissibility is supplied by the Godunov/HLLC backbone and checked after reconstruction. The earlier direct Euler CSE-PINN no-entropy run remains a one-seed development ablation and must be reported separately, not merged with this table.
